stages.name: select
stages.note: kept 17 of 18 by concept overlap with the question (hydroxymethylglutaryl-coa, hydroxymethylglutaryl-coa reductase inhibitors, rhabdomyolysis, statine), where a cluster side counts as overlapping if it IS a query concept or belongs to a pharmacological class the query named (ADR-0022, member->class only); ordered by relevance to the query (ADR-0020: matched sides, then MeSH hierarchy proximity, then key order; size is deliberately not a signal).

stages.name: critic
stages.note: Contradiction detection is not implemented. The CTD-derived gold standard was retired by Gate 2 (pi-hat = 0.067) and the re-scoped alternative was declined; see ADR-0017.
